irregularities_found_this_session.detail: Note 7 says 'All subsequent buy in's after the initial buy in will be $200', implying more than one buy-in may be possible, yet the sheet has no re-entry procedure. Entry limit is ambiguous; not confirmed single-entry.

No Venetian DSE IV structure sheet read to date contains an express 'single entry / freezeout / no re-entry' clause. Classification as single-entry rests on the absence of any re-entry, rebuy or add-on mechanism in a fully read sheet that enumerates exactly one fee split and one late-registration window. Absence of language is not an express confirmation; confirm with the poker room before nonrefundable payment.
The official guide confirms a $50 add-on for 15,000 chips at the first break — a spend-more mechanism. Re-entry is not addressed on the guide.
Official page confirms unlimited re-entries until level 5 and up to two $20 add-ons, but does not state the buy-in amount. Buy-in left blank.

Official poker page lists daily tournament times (11:00am, 7:00pm, 11:00pm) but no buy-ins or guarantees; those live on the weekly-schedule PDF. Rows carry times only, with buy-in blank until the PDF is re-read.
